snippet.description:
How many subjects should you study at a time for UPSC Mains 2027? Sonia Ma’am recommends focusing on no more than two subjects at once to avoid stretching your preparation and delaying completion.

In this Short, learn why completing subjects in manageable timeframes can create a sense of achievement, improve motivation, and help you stay consistent with your UPSC preparation.

Focus on fewer subjects. Complete them. Move forward.
